clips.title: The story
paras: Sapphires of Aku'Mai are glowing, water-infused mineral clusters growing along the subterranean tunnels of Blackfathom Deeps. The encroaching naga have begun harvesting these gems, prompting the Earthen Ring to seek them out before their potent arcane power can be exploited.

Discovered within the watery cavern entrances of Blackfathom Deeps along Ashenvale's Zoram Strand, Sapphires of Aku'Mai are crystalline formations rich in elemental energy. The spirits of water cling tightly to them, making them exceptional catalysts for magical workings. When scouts reported that the subterranean naga had begun actively quarrying these clusters from the cavern walls, the Shaman Je'neu Sancrea sought adventuring assistance to confiscate them. Left in the serpent peoples' clutches, the stones could easily fuel devastating arcane rites.
